cards_qr_network_diag.es:
No se pudo conectar al backend de QR.

Checklist rápido:
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_API_URL con IP LAN (no localhost)
• Backend activo en puerto 4000
• Móvil y PC en la misma Wi‑Fi
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_GATEWAY_KEY igual a API_GATEWAY_KEY del backend{{androidHint}}
cards_qr_network_diag.en:
Could not connect to the QR backend.

Quick checklist:
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_API_URL uses LAN IP (not localhost)
• Backend is running on port 4000
• Phone and PC are on the same Wi‑Fi
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_GATEWAY_KEY matches backend API_GATEWAY_KEY{{androidHint}}
cards_qr_network_diag.it:
Impossibile connettersi al backend QR.

Checklist:
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_API_URL su IP LAN (non localhost)
• Backend sulla porta 4000
• Telefono e PC sulla stessa Wi‑Fi
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_GATEWAY_KEY = API_GATEWAY_KEY del backend{{androidHint}}
cards_qr_network_diag.pt:
Falha ao conectar ao backend de QR.

Checklist:
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_API_URL com IP LAN (não localhost)
• Backend na porta 4000
• Celular e PC na mesma Wi‑Fi
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_GATEWAY_KEY = API_GATEWAY_KEY{{androidHint}}
cards_qr_network_diag.fr:
Connexion au backend QR impossible.

Checklist :
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_API_URL en IP LAN (pas localhost)
• Backend sur le port 4000
• Téléphone et PC sur le même Wi‑Fi
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_GATEWAY_KEY = API_GATEWAY_KEY{{androidHint}}
cards_qr_network_diag.de:
Verbindung zum QR-Backend fehlgeschlagen.

Kurz-Checkliste:
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_API_URL mit LAN-IP (nicht localhost)
• Backend auf Port 4000
• Telefon und PC im selben WLAN
• EXPO_PUBLIC_MODERATION_GATEWAY_KEY = API_GATEWAY_KEY im Backend{{androidHint}}
